blocks.text: 10Signal ("10Signal", "we", "us", or "our") is an independent digital platform developed and operated by a two-person team based in Türkiye.

For the purposes of the European Union General Data Protection Regulation (Regulation (EU) 2016/679, "GDPR"), the Turkish Law on the Protection of Personal Data (Law No. 6698, "KVKK"), and other applicable international data privacy frameworks, 10Signal acts as the data controller for personal data collected directly through the 10Signal application and associated services.
This Privacy Policy serves as our statutory notice under GDPR Articles 13 and 14 and constitutes our general disclosure statement pursuant to Article 10 of the KVKK.
All communications, inquiries, and statutory data subject requests should be directed to our designated privacy channel at: 10signal.me@gmail.com

**Core Commitment:** 10Signal is built exclusively for personal and social self-reflection. We do not sell, rent, monetize, or trade your personal information, self-evaluations, or peer ratings to third-party data brokers, advertising networks, or commercial profile aggregators.

We collect and process only the categories of personal data that are strictly necessary to provide our core self-discovery features, maintain system security, and comply with operational requirements.
A. Account and Profile Data

items: Account identifier (UUID);
User-selected display name;
Email address (used for one-time password [OTP] authentication, security notices, transactional receipts, and customer support);
Selected visual avatar asset identifier;
Account entitlement tier (Standard vs. 10Signal Plus) and response capacity limits;
Interface language preference (e.g., 'en' or 'tr');
Account creation, name update, and last activity timestamps.

blocks.text: B. Self-Assessment and Psychometric Response Data

items: Numerical rating responses (values 1 through 5) submitted voluntarily to self-evaluation questions across 10 social perception lenses: Warmth (Samimiyet), Charm (Çekicilik), Intellect (Zeka), Vision (Vizyon), Energy (Enerji), Reliability (Güvenilirlik), Confidence (Ego), Drive/Success (Başarı), Generosity (Cömertlik), and Maturity (Olgunluk);
Calculated trait score averages, archetype card classifications, perception gap vectors, and confidence band states.

blocks.text: C. Peer (Friend) Assessment Data

items: Numerical evaluations (values 1 through 5) submitted by peer participants via your public profile link (/friend/{slug});
Optional respondent nickname voluntarily entered by the participant (participants may choose to leave this field blank);
Per-question completion duration analytics (response latency in milliseconds);
Important: Peer respondents are NEVER required to provide their email address, real name, phone number, or login credentials.

blocks.text: D. Technical Identifiers, Network and Anti-Abuse Data

items: Pseudonymous network hash: When an HTTP request reaches 10Signal, the client's IP address is used in temporary server memory solely to compute an irreversible SHA-256 hash. The raw IP address is NEVER stored in persistent database tables;

Pseudonymous device fingerprint hash: A client-generated browser signal converted on our servers into an irreversible SHA-256 hash solely to enforce a strict one-vote-per-device-per-profile constraint;
Rate-limit bucket counters, access timestamps, and security audit event logs.

blocks.text: E. Payment and Commercial Transaction Records

Payments are processed entirely through our Merchant of Record, Lemon Squeezy, LLC. 10Signal never collects, stores, or accesses full credit card numbers, expiration dates, or CVV/CVC security codes. We receive and store only transaction metadata: transaction ID, checkout ID, product code, entitlement quantity, purchase currency, amount in minor units, payment status, and entitlement grant timestamps.
F. Communications and Verification Grants

Cryptographically hashed OTP verification codes and short-lived registration grants (with a maximum lifespan of 10 to 30 minutes).

sections.title: Assessment Mechanics, Non-Clinical Psychometrics & Profiling Safeguards

blocks.text: 10Signal utilizes algorithmic scoring formulas to compute normalized averages, archetype classifications, and perception gap vectors based upon self-ratings and peer feedback.

**Strict Non-Clinical Disclaimer:** 10Signal assessments, archetypes, radar charts, and perception gap scores are designed strictly for personal reflection, interpersonal self-awareness, communication insights, and entertainment. 10Signal does NOT offer medical, psychological, psychiatric, or healthcare services. Our algorithms do NOT generate clinical diagnoses, mental health assessments, psychiatric evaluations, or medical treatment recommendations.
No High-Impact Automated Decision-Making (GDPR Article 22)

10Signal does NOT subject users to automated decision-making or profiling that produces legal effects or similarly significantly affects them under GDPR Article 22 or KVKK Article 11(1)(g). Our calculations are confined entirely to user-facing reflection archetypes. They are never utilized for credit underwriting, insurance pricing, employment suitability screening, judicial evaluation, or behavioral commercial gating.
Zero Processing of Special Category / Sensitive Personal Data

Under Article 9 of the GDPR and Article 6 of the KVKK, certain categories of data receive heightened protection, including race, ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, genetic data, biometric data for identification, health or medical data, and information concerning sex life or sexual orientation. 10Signal strictly DOES NOT collect, solicit, or process any special category personal data. Users and peer respondents must never enter sensitive health, political, religious, or biometric data into open-text fields, nicknames, or support correspondence.
Peer evaluation is a core feature of 10Signal. We have implemented robust technical safeguards to protect the privacy and anonymity of participating peers.

items: No Credentials Required: Peers access evaluations via a public link (/friend/{slug}). They are not required to create an account, log in, or provide an email address, phone number, or legal identity.
Optional Pseudonyms: A participant may voluntarily choose an arbitrary nickname. If omitted, the session remains completely unlabelled.

Enforced Minimum Aggregation Threshold: To ensure that profile owners cannot isolate or reverse-engineer the ratings of a single individual, outside perception scores and friend averages are strictly locked until a minimum threshold of at least three (3) unique evaluations have been submitted.

Owner History Protections: When a profile owner views detailed response cards, voter network hashes and device fingerprint hashes are stripped and NEVER exposed to the owner or returned in public API payloads.

Confidentiality Guarantee: 10Signal does not track, deanonymize, or disclose the identity of anonymous participants to profile owners upon private request, except where disclosure is strictly mandated by valid legal process or judicial court order.

blocks.text: To prevent ballot manipulation, spamming, and denial-of-service abuse while preserving privacy, 10Signal relies on one-way cryptographic hashing rather than raw identifier storage.
A. Network IP Address Policy

When an HTTP request is received by our servers, the client's remote IP address is temporarily read in volatile memory solely to calculate an irreversible SHA-256 hash formatted as network:v1:[IP]. The raw IP address is NEVER written to or stored in persistent database tables.
B. Browser Environment Fingerprint Signals

When a peer submits an evaluation, a client-derived browser environment signal is sent to the server. The server immediately applies a one-way cryptographic SHA-256 hash (fingerprint:v1:[signal]). This hash is used solely to enforce a strict unique constraint (one response per device per profile) and cannot be reverse-engineered to track users across third-party websites.
C. Rate Limiting and Automated Periodic Cleanup

Rate limiting is enforced at the database layer through dedicated rate-limit bucket tables. An automated background cleanup scheduler runs every hour, purging expired rate-limit records, expired OTP challenges, and expired verification grants with an operational retention window of 24 hours.

10Signal operates without third-party advertising cookies, commercial tracking pixels, or cross-site tracking scripts. We utilize only strictly necessary browser storage mechanisms to ensure service functionality.
A. Local Storage (localStorage)

items: tensignal_owner_token / seenly_owner_token: Stores the cryptographic owner session token required for authenticated access to your private profile and dashboard;
tensignal_locale, tensignal_account_locale, tensignal_locale_manual: Stores your preferred UI language selection (e.g., 'en' or 'tr');
tensignal_display_name, tensignal_avatar, tensignal_owner_slug, tensignal_is_premium: Caches non-sensitive profile state to enable instantaneous interface rendering;
tensignal_participant_signal: Temporarily stores a client signal used to verify whether you have completed an evaluation on a given profile link.

blocks.text: B. Session Storage (sessionStorage)

items: tensignal_answers, tensignal_currentIndex: Holds your in-progress quiz responses during an active browser session so progress is not lost upon accidental page refresh;
tensignal_registration_grant: Stores a transient cryptographic token utilized during the email verification workflow;
Lifecycle: Session storage is automatically cleared upon quiz submission, account sign-out, or browser tab closure.

Service Providers Processing Data Internationally

Recipient email addresses and notification payloads for one-time login codes (OTPs), security alerts, account deletion notices, and lifecycle messages are processed within Brevo's data centers located in the European Union (France and Germany).

blocks.text: Transfers under European Union GDPR (Chapter V)

For users located in the European Economic Area (EEA), transactional email processing via Brevo is conducted directly within the European Union. Payment processing flows with Lemon Squeezy in the United States are conducted pursuant to standard data processing terms and derogations for the performance of the purchase contract (GDPR Article 49(1)(b)).
Status under Turkish KVKK (Article 9)

Under Article 9 of the Turkish Law on the Protection of Personal Data (KVKK, as amended in 2024), continuous and systematic transfers of personal data from Türkiye to foreign jurisdictions require an adequacy decision issued by the Personal Data Protection Board (Article 9(1)) or appropriate safeguards such as standard contractual clauses formally notified to the Authority or Board-approved commitments (Article 9(4)). Statutory derogations under Article 9(6) apply strictly to occasional transfers.

10Signal operates as an independent two-person venture and currently does not have an adequacy decision from the Board, formal Standard Contractual Clauses notified to the Turkish Authority, or approved commitments in place for destination jurisdictions. Users are hereby informed that utilizing the platform's authentication, notification, and payment features involves the technical processing of data by the aforementioned international providers. Users may terminate these technical processing flows at any time by requesting account deletion.

sections.title: Data Retention, Account Deletion & Anonymization Lifecycle

blocks.text: We retain personal data only for as long as strictly necessary to deliver the requested services, maintain security, enforce duplicate response restrictions, and comply with legal retention requirements.
A. Active Account Data
Profile details, self-evaluations, and peer response sessions remain stored while your account remains active.
B. Account Deletion Execution Flow
You may permanently delete your account at any time via the Settings menu or by emailing 10signal.me@gmail.com. When account deletion is triggered (/api/billing/delete-account):

items: Immediate Database Cascade: The user record, all linked 10Signal profiles, self-evaluation answers, result snapshots, and all peer response sessions and friend evaluations are permanently deleted from active database tables immediately;

Asynchronous Outbox Scrubbing: A final account deletion confirmation email is enqueued for delivery. When the background email outbox worker successfully dispatches this notice via Brevo (or upon terminal failure or 24-hour expiration), the recipient email on that outbox record is overwritten with purged@deleted.tensignal.app and its payload is wiped to empty JSON ({});
Session Invalidation: All active owner authentication tokens and browser session credentials are instantaneously revoked.

blocks.text: C. Operational and Commercial Retention

items: OTP Challenges and Grants: Expire after 10 to 30 minutes and are permanently purged by hourly automated cleanup jobs;
Rate-Limit Records: Expire after their configured window and are purged within 24 hours;

Commercial Transaction Records: In accordance with statutory financial, fiscal, and tax recordkeeping laws, payment transaction logs may be retained for statutory limitation periods (up to 10 years where required by applicable commercial codes).

blocks.text: 10Signal implements multi-layered technical and organizational safeguards designed to protect personal data against accidental loss, unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, and misuse.

items: Encryption in Transit: All data exchanged between your browser and our servers is encrypted using modern TLS (Transport Layer Security 1.2 and 1.3) with strict HTTPS enforcement;
Cryptographic Token Hashing: Owner access tokens are stored in the database exclusively as irreversible SHA-256 cryptographic hashes, preventing plain-text credential exposure;
Pseudonymization by Design: Client IP addresses and device signals are immediately salted and hashed before database persistence;
Outbox Payload Encryption: Sensitive OTP authentication payloads stored in our transactional email outbox queue are encrypted at rest using AES-256-GCM;
Database Rate Limiting: Strict rate-limiting algorithms guard against automated brute-force attacks, credential stuffing, and volumetric denial-of-service attempts;
Strict Header Authentication: Private dashboard endpoints mandate valid cryptographic X-Owner-Token headers and reject URL-based token exposure.

sections.title: Data Subject Rights under GDPR and KVKK

blocks.text: We respect your statutory rights regarding your personal data under the EU GDPR, the Turkish KVKK, and comparable international data protection frameworks.
Rights under the EU GDPR (Articles 15–22)

items: Right of Access (Article 15): Request confirmation as to whether we process your personal data and obtain a copy of that data;
Right to Rectification (Article 16): Request the correction of inaccurate or incomplete personal data;
Right to Erasure / Right to be Forgotten (Article 17): Request permanent deletion of personal data where statutory grounds apply;
Right to Restriction of Processing (Article 18): Request the restriction of processing under specified legal conditions;
Right to Data Portability (Article 20): Receive your personal data in a structured, commonly used, and machine-readable format;
Right to Object (Article 21): Object to data processing based upon our legitimate interests;
Rights Regarding Profiling (Article 22): Right not to be subjected to decisions based solely on automated processing having legal or significant effects;
Right to Lodge a Complaint: You have the right to lodge a complaint with a competent supervisory authority in your EU Member State.

blocks.text: Rights under the Turkish KVKK (Article 11)

items: Learn whether your personal data is being processed;
Request information if your personal data has been processed;
Learn the purpose of the processing and whether data is used in accordance with that purpose;
Know the third parties to whom personal data is transferred domestically or abroad;
Request correction of incomplete or inaccurate data;
Request deletion or destruction of personal data pursuant to Article 7 of the KVKK;
Request notification of corrections, deletions, or destructions to third parties to whom your data was transferred;
Object to results that emerge exclusively through automated systems to your detriment;
Claim compensation for damages suffered as a result of unlawful processing of personal data.

Valid requests will be processed free of charge and answered without undue delay, and in all cases within thirty (30) days as stipulated by both GDPR and KVKK.
10Signal is not intended for or targeted at individuals under 16 years of age (or the minimum legal age for digital consent under the laws of your jurisdiction).

We do not knowingly solicit, collect, or process personal data from children under 16. If we discover that personal data of a minor under 16 has been collected without verified parental or legal guardian consent, we will take immediate steps to delete the information and terminate the associated profile. If you believe a minor has submitted personal data to 10Signal, please contact us at: 10signal.me@gmail.com

sections.title: No Voluntary Refunds for Digital Purchases

blocks.text: 10Signal does not offer voluntary refunds for digital purchases, including Plus access and Response Capacity Packs. Changing your mind, not using the purchased features, or leaving purchased capacity unused does not, by itself, qualify for a voluntary refund. This policy does not limit any withdrawal, refund, or other consumer rights that cannot lawfully be excluded.
Due to the immediate provisioning of digital capacity, voluntary refunds will not be granted under the following scenarios:

items: Leaving purchased response capacity unused on your profile;
Subjective dissatisfaction with ratings, perception cards, or archetype scores submitted by friends;
Voluntary account deletion or abandonment after completing a purchase;
Account suspension or restrictions resulting from violations of our Terms of Service.

blocks.text: Discontinuation of Past Discretionary Guarantees: The previously advertised 14-day refund period for unused packs has been discontinued for all future transactions. Purchases completed under prior policy versions remain subject to the terms in force at the time of purchase.

If a verified technical glitch, gateway timeout, or network error results in duplicate charges for the same order, the redundant charge will be promptly refunded to your original payment method upon review.

If payment is successfully collected by Lemon Squeezy but digital entitlements fail to activate on your 10Signal account due to a technical error, we will manually credit the purchased entitlements or provide an appropriate remedy.

Nothing in this Refund Policy excludes, restricts, or modifies any statutory consumer guarantees, rights of withdrawal, or legal remedies that apply to you under mandatory applicable consumer protection laws (including Turkish Law No. 6502 and EU Directive 2011/83/EU).
To report a duplicate transaction or make a billing inquiry, please contact our support team from the email address registered to your account at: 10signal.me@gmail.com
